text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen had finally 
arrived—and gathered there were the 
heavyweights dominating the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Garnering the most attention are T.M. 
Opera O, known as the End of Century 
Overlord, and her rival, Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Manhattan Cafe's gaze was 
directed elsewhere entirely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Believing that today might finally be the 
day she could catch up to the "friend" she 
had chased since childhood, she headed 
toward the track.
